recipe.visualDefinition: A composite layout featuring a central framed black-and-white band portrait set against a deep blue nocturnal landscape, enclosed by a thick red outer border and multi-colored inner pinstriping.
coreVisualRelationships: A framed monochromatic human subject centered against a saturated blue background.
A silhouette of dark trees at the bottom grounding the composition.
A multi-line geometric frame separating the central photo from the background.
Bold, stylized display typography positioned at the top and within the frame.
coreInvariants: Deep red outer border framing the entire square composition.
High-contrast blue-to-black gradient in the lower landscape half.
Multi-colored pinstripe frame (yellow, green, red) around the central photo.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central rectangular frame containing a group portrait, occupying approximately 40% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central black-and-white photograph of the band and motorcycle.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top display text, down to the central portrait, then to the dark tree silhouettes at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial blue space in the lower half and surrounding the central frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt blue background and deep red outer border.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white central photography providing tonal contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow, green, and red pinstripes in the inner frame.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the borders and background contrasting with the desaturated central image.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with rounded terminals and inline details.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy drop shadows or 3D extrusions on secondary text.
characterSpecificRedesigns: O-characters containing internal graphic elements like moons or eyes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A tubular, airy display face paired with a heavy, blocky slab-serif for internal emphasis.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rounded, geometric 70s aesthetic of the top text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Stymie Black or Rockwell Extra Bold
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif block style of the internal text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square composition with a thick red outer border. The main background is a deep cobalt blue night scene with a dark silhouette of pine trees at the bottom. In the upper center, place a rectangular frame with thin multi-colored pinstripes (yellow, green, red). Inside this frame, place a grainy black-and-white photograph of a 1970s rock band standing around a vintage motorcycle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase decorative inline text centered at the top in a rounded 70s style. Add a second block of heavy, red slab-serif text with a thick black drop shadow in the upper right corner of the inner photograph.

verificationChecks: Is the outer border a consistent solid red?
Does the central photo have a grainy, monochromatic film quality?
Are the pinstripes around the photo distinct and multi-colored?
Is the blue background deep and saturated?
Is the typography stylized with 70s-era characteristics like inlines and heavy shadows?

adjustableVariables: Grain level of the central photo
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red border is perfectly square.
Check that the inline text is legible despite the decorative style.
Verify the tree silhouettes do not overlap the central frame.
Confirm the drop shadow on the internal text is heavy and black.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square format + Red border + Blue night landscape + Framed B&W photo + 70s Display Typography.
